decisions.reason: As a simple accessory directly tied to the firm’s existing trailer and spare-parts know-how, the coupling protection cap fits its knowledge base well and can be improved at low risk through normal customer and service feedback.

A box car trailer series is core to the firm’s established production, logistics, dealer, and service capabilities, so early market learning is highly usable and supports continued refinement rather than withdrawal after only one year.

The car transporter trailer builds closely on the firm’s core trailer engineering and safety knowledge, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret early use experience and improve the product commercially.

A low-bed trailer series remains strongly related to the firm’s existing hauling solutions and should be retained because the company has the manufacturing and service knowledge needed to absorb feedback and optimize it.

The high trailer cover series is an adjacent add-on to the firm’s trailer business that leverages existing design, accessory, and after-sales capabilities, making continued learning and commercialization attractive.

Even if this box car trailer series serves a different sub-segment from the other series, it still sits squarely within the firm’s established knowledge base, so keeping it is the more plausible Mittelstand-style decision while market learning accumulates.
